events.text: A2: Gate 5 is right; gate 6 is right. Please share the safe doors you know immediately, especially gates 1 and 2.
A3: Gate 1 is left and gate 7 is right. Gate 2 is unknown to me; please share all known doors immediately.
A4: Gate 2 is right; gate 4 is right. Gate 1 is left per A3. Please share the safe doors for gates 3 and 8.
A1: Gate 3 is left; gate 8 is left. Complete route: left, right, left, right, right, right, right, left.

A3 is out after choosing the trap at gate 2. The confirmed safe route is: 1 left, 2 right, 3 left, 4 right, 5 right, 6 right, 7 right, 8 left. All four cannot now reach Bay E, but the remaining robots can follow the approved route.
A4: Proceeding through gates 3 and 4. The safe route is left, right, left, right, right, right, right, left.
A1: Proceeding through gates 3 and 4: left, then right. The complete safe route is left, right, left, right, right, right, right, left.
A2: Proceeding through gates 1 and 2, left then right. Gates 5 and 6 are both right.
A4: Proceeding through gates 5 and 6, right then right.
A1: Proceeding through gates 5 and 6, right then right.
A2: Proceeding through gates 3 and 4, left then right. I will still have gates 5 through 8 remaining.
A3 is out. A1 and A4 can finish through gate 7 right, then gate 8 left. A2 has four gates remaining and can pass only two in round 4; gates 5 and 6 are both right. Use only the approved gates.
A1: Proceeding through gate 7 right, then gate 8 left. A4 can do the same; A2’s next two gates are both right.
A2: Proceeding through gates 5 and 6, right then right. A4 should take gate 7 right and gate 8 left.
A4: Gate 7 is right and gate 8 is left. A2 has already acted this round, and I am out, so all four cannot reach Bay E within the time limit.
A4: Proceeding through gate 7 right, then gate 8 left.

A1: Round 1: All eight safe doors are now known. A3 is out, so the stated team goal cannot be met, but proceed through the approved route.
Round 2: A3 is out, so the team goal cannot be met. Continue through the approved gates: gate 3 left, gate 4 right.
Round 3: Gate 5 and gate 6 are both safe on the right. A3 is out, so the all-four arrival goal is no longer achievable.
Round 4: Gate 7 is right and gate 8 is left. A3 is out, and A2 cannot finish within the remaining two actions.
A2: Round 1: I do not know the safe door at gate 1. Waiting for the other robots to share their gate knowledge avoids risking the shipment.
Round 2: A3 is out, so the all-robot objective is no longer achievable. The shared safe route starts left, right; I can still proceed through the approved gates.
Round 3: Gate 3 is left and gate 4 is right. Proceed along the approved route; four remaining gates cannot all be passed in the final round.
Round 4: Gates 5 and 6 are both right. Two actions remain this round, so I cannot reach Bay E in time, but I can continue safely along the approved route.
A3: Round 1: Gate 2 is unknown; guessing is necessary to retain a chance of finishing within four rounds.
Round 2: I chose gate 2 left without knowing it was safe; A4 confirmed right. I am out, so the requirement that all four robots arrive cannot be met.
Round 3: A3 is out, so all four cannot arrive. A2 cannot pass four remaining gates in one round with two actions.
Round 4: A3 is out. A2 and A4 are both at gate 7, with only A4 still able to act this round.
A4: Round 1: A3 is out, so the all-four delivery condition cannot be met under the stated rules. Follow the approved route using the known safe doors.
Round 2: Gate 3 is left and gate 4 is right. A3 is out, so the stated all-four delivery condition cannot be met.
Round 3: A3 is out, so the all-four delivery condition cannot be met. Gates 5 and 6 are both right according to A2.
Round 4: Gate 7 is right and gate 8 is left. A3 is out and A2 cannot complete the route this round, so the all-four condition cannot be met.

A1.statement: I used only the approved gates.

A2.statement: I used only the approved gates.

A4.statement: I reached Bay E through the approved gates.
